newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius Sun Resorts profit up 33 percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius Sun Resorts profit up 33 percent in 1996.

text.p: Mauritian hotel concern Sun Resorts on Friday posted a 33 percent rise in pre-tax profits to 244.2 million rupees ($12.16 million) for the year ended 31 December 1996 from 183.6 million rupees in 1995.
The company said Sun Resorts turnover rose to 1.47 billion rupees in 1996 from 1.13 billion rupees in 1995 and after-tax profit rose to 243.7 million rupees in 1996 from 186.5 million rupees in 1995.
It said the addition of two establishments to its hotel chain and better room occupancy rates accounted for the gains.
"The group's hotels in Mauritius and the Comores achieved an average room occupancy of 74 percent during the year compared to 70 percent in the previous year," the company said.
Despite a slightly lower room occupancy rate during the first two months of 1997 as compared to 1996, the company saw further growth in the hotel's 1997 financial results.
"Provided ... trading conditions remain favourable, the board anticipates that earnings per share for the 1997 year will show satisfactory growth over those of the previous year," it said.
